metadata.basis: Nominal 1978–1979 engineering planning allowances, not historical quotations or agreed contract prices. No present-value conversion.
metadata.scope: One-time costs and optional supplier purchase scenarios separate from recurring product costs.

dri_founding.cost_classification: Equity funding, not a manufacturing expense; no per-unit amortization.

smc_transfer.nre_status: Illustrative budget, not a committed payment; AION/Logix fund transfer. No unit-cost allocation without production volumes.

nre_items.name: Process adaptation, layout and engineering support
SMC-compatible mask sets, test structures and revisions
Pilot wafers, characterization and corrective runs

nre_exclusions: New fab equipment, facilities and major process-capacity expansion
Logix card design and driver development
smc_transfer.feasibility: October 1979 initial sales plausible with characterized AION silicon, SMC-compatible masks by late 1978 and successful qualification. Family-wide availability/mature yield is not guaranteed. video RAM may require additional process investment beyond this allowance.

purchase_price_proxy.basis: Sensitivity relative to modeled AION internal cost, including SMC overhead/margin/capital recovery and embedded royalty. No exact royalty rate, quote or guaranteed cost advantage is inferred.

sources.use: SMC 1979 catalog supports custom MOS, supplied-mask production and peripheral/display capability; does not substantiate these budgets or prove AION video RAM process compatibility.
